candidates: [TECH] When assessing images with intentional low-light or high-contrast effects, do not automatically penalize noise or loss of detail; instead, evaluate whether the effect serves the image’s intended mood or atmosphere.
[AESTH] If an image uses soft focus, vignetting, or desaturation for artistic effect, score it based on emotional impact rather than technical fidelity alone.
[CONTENT] When judging images with unusual subjects (e.g., microscopic views, abstract patterns), prioritize clarity of subject matter over conventional photographic standards.
[NATURAL] In scenes with non-natural lighting (e.g., neon, stage lights), assess color rendering relative to the scene’s context rather than absolute realism.
[GLOBAL] When scoring images with mixed qualities, weigh overall visual harmony and viewer engagement more heavily than isolated technical metrics.
